chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Abū Jamīlah, from Muḥammad al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever separates from the community of the Muslims by the measure of a handspan has indeed cast off the bond of Islam from his neck.

key_terms.الْإِسْلَامِ: Islam, the religion of submission to Allah
key_terms.رِبْقَةَ: the bond, yoke, or binding tie

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean about separating from the community of Muslims?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly warns against breaking away from the جماعة of the Muslims and severing one’s binding attachment to the religion. Its significance lies in emphasizing communal cohesion, loyalty to rightful religious authority, and the grave danger of alienation from the Muslim body.
